description: An older man with long black hair under a patterned headband, wearing a red and brown woven poncho with geometric bands, a gold earring and a gold pendant, leans forward and drives a long gold staff into the dirt of a grassy hillside. Behind him, three people in dark shawls watch, one holding a bundle to her chest and another carrying a pack on his back with a walking stick. The setting is a high, rocky mountain valley under a heavy storm sky with bright light breaking through the clouds. No text, border or frame is visible, and nothing is graphic.
